items.title: Total combinations vs. distinct pairs, as flag count grows
items.description: Two different counts from the same n flags: the total number of on/off combinations (2^n) grows exponentially, while the number of distinct pairs to check (nC2) grows much more slowly. For pairs, nC2 is the same as n(n-1)/2 because A-B and B-A are the same pair. Drag the flag count to see the gap widen — this is exactly why exhaustive testing becomes impractical long before pairwise coverage does.
items.compute: const totalCombinations = Math.pow(2, params.numFlags); const distinctPairs = (params.numFlags * (params.numFlags - 1)) / 2; return { totalCombinations, distinctPairs };
